name: Shen Zheng
source: Shen is a powerful warlock Nova meets in the Vatican catacombs at the beginning of the book. He discovers that she is a time catcher, a rare witch, and realizes that this could help Others' cause, so he tells his ally and friend Vesper who is interested in meeting her.
